intent: Compare two parallel options side by side using large track cards with structured label/value rows.
invariants: exactly 2 track cards side by side (6 cols each), equal width
each card has a dark (accent_1) header with track name (section_title token style) and profile subtitle
card body uses label/value rows: kicker-styled label on left, body text on right
cards have subtle border (accent_6 line) on white background
subtitle line spans full width above the cards
footer note at bottom of body region in kicker style
max 2 accent colors: accent_1 for card headers, accent_2 for row labels
variables: profile subtitle text (e.g. '0-2 yrs experience | external + internal')
number of label/value rows per card (2-5)
value text length (10-200 chars per row)
header bar kicker and title text
